body: Commit 64639be (+ CHANGELOG). apps/arena_training/src/headless.c mirrors SHANKPIT's own headless.c shape (sim_init/sim_step) but exposes a small fixed 18-float obs array instead of a raw struct pointer, avoiding fragile ctypes.Structure ABI mirroring of the large, still-growing ArenaState. Verified via live ctypes round-trip (real combat over 200 ticks, real reset) + 6 new C tests. Full suite green.
title: S170-224: ctypes-callable RL environment API
